title: Client-Side Router, Route Guards & Lazy Loading
description: The ferrox-front-router crate delivers client-side SPA navigation for WebAssembly apps. It features HTML5 History API integration, route path parameter matching, nested layout outlets, route protection guards, and code-split WebAssembly module lazy loading.
